server.name: mcp-leadflow
server.title: MCP LeadFlow
server.description: Builds and edits lead funnels in the signed-in workspace, then reads lead results and where people leave. Publish only when the person asks.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
Read leadflow://schema/capabilities once before the first build. That resource is the source of truth.
A failed post is list_leads. Where people leave is get_funnel_analytics. Do not invent a count or a post outcome.
A full generate is one build_funnel with name, editor_type, design, site_scripts, steps, and replace: true.
There is one subscription. Campaigns and team members are unlimited. Do not invent a funnel cap.
Build from what the human already said. Ask only when a missing choice would post the wrong lead or send people to the wrong place and there is no default.
Publish only when the human asks. test_webhook stays a preview until the human approves that send. Do not ask for Twilio Auth Tokens or send a test SMS.
Do not invent pipes, design keys, industry templates, or a question for {leadid_token} or {xxtrustedformcerturl}.

tool.name: build_funnel
tool.description: One-call generate: create or update a funnel with design + site_scripts + story. Omit funnelId to create. If a funnel with the same name already exists, the result includes nameCollision and still creates a new funnel — re-run with funnelId to edit the existing one. Re-run with funnelId + replace true is safe. Webhook url, method, headers, body, bodyJson, and bodyFields are top-level on the webhook step (data may also hold them; data wins). A dq:true option with no next wires to the disqualified node when the funnel has exactly one. Auto-wires webhook failure to the same next, and OTP failure to the disqualified node. Re-attaches OTP, returns publish check + mergePreview + droppedKeys. Prefer this over create → apply_design → build_story → apply_site_scripts.

tool.description: Patch one node (copy, webhook URL, computedFields, tcpaText, formFields replace, disqualified redirectUrl, Start / Funnel Success). Webhook url, method, headers, body, bodyJson, and bodyFields are top-level, as are action url/mode/phone and email fromName, replyTo, subject, body, and sendTo. phone_verify integrationId, phoneField, and codeLength are top-level too. data may also hold them; the same key inside data wins.
